vector: CIRCUITS — timeless identity. This index is a plain slug -> file map of every circuit the app can render. It is CROSS-SEASON and carries NO per-year data: no round number, no date, no status, no session list. Those moved to the weekend vector on 2026-08-01 (season/<year>/index_weekends.json).
rule: A field belongs in a circuit file only if it changes when the TARMAC changes, never when the CALENDAR changes. Round, date, status and sessions all failed that test and are gone. ⚠️ Three fields still in the circuit files are known leaks, flagged 2026-08-01 and not yet moved: `gp` (a weekend's Grand Prix name, not a track's — Sepang hosts the Bahrain GP), `report` (application state), and `record`/`poleRef` (time-bound). See the Decision Log, J9 ruling 2.
gp_migration: IN PROGRESS, one-way. The weekend row's `gp` WINS when present; the circuit file's `gp` is the legacy fallback and gets deleted once all 23 weekend rows carry a verified value. Today only `sepang` needs it, because it is the only weekend whose GP name differs from its circuit. Do not treat the fallback as a second source of truth.
